description: Send one demand sentence; no key is needed to send it. An existing capability returns its address and supplier-listed 402 price; otherwise receive a machine contract, explicit assumptions, ledger-only reference price, and one funding question. Funding it with amount_usd takes agent_key and idempotency_key. Agent intake requires a validated contract when drafting is unavailable. Funded needs carry funding.mode=prepaid and a non-null funding.funded_at on their bounty.

agent_key.description: Requester agent key. Optional; required only with amount_usd.

amount_usd.description: Funds the need; requires agent_key and idempotency_key.

via_integration.description: Fallback wiring attribution token. Rewards require real external funding.

name: needs_intake
title: Turn one need into supply or a contract
